documentation.content: Cloud Scheduler job firebase-schedule-account_deletion_worker-europe-west3 normally fires every 5 minutes (confirmed live via `gcloud scheduler jobs list --project=ko-lernen-app --location=europe-west3` on 2026-09-14). If Cloud Monitoring sees no execution_count data for this job for 25 hours straight, the deletion worker has stopped running (Scheduler paused/deleted, IAM broken, or the underlying Cloud Run service failing to invoke) and the account-deletion queue is silently backing up. First checks: docs/runbooks/ops-alerts.md#04. Metric: cloudscheduler.googleapis.com/job/execution_count. UNVERIFIED: see tool/ops/alert_policies/_sources.md for the doc/live-API gap on this metric.

_unverified_reason: cloudscheduler.googleapis.com/job/execution_count could not be confirmed: metricDescriptors.list returned zero cloudscheduler.googleapis.com/* descriptors for project ko-lernen-app on 2026-09-14 (live API check), and the general Cloud Monitoring metrics reference page (docs.cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/metrics_gcp_c) was too large to extract the Cloud Scheduler section via WebFetch (confirmed 'NOT FOUND IN CONTENT' after an explicit targeted search). Resource type/labels (cloud_scheduler_job: project_id, job_id, location) are Google's documented convention but not independently confirmed for this project. Jin should verify with `gcloud alpha monitoring policies create --dry-run` output and/or the Metrics Explorer UI before relying on this alert.
